# Canonical Records

<!-- Generated by Secomm Production AI Toolkit (Phase 1a). Nằm tại: .ai/records/ -->
<!-- Một feature / bug / release / durable decision = MỘT record (single source of truth). -->
<!-- Frontmatter là contract — `bin/project-ai-validate --check-records` parse + resolve links. -->

This directory holds the **canonical work-item records** for this project. Each record is the primary Markdown source of truth for one unit of work — it replaces the older spread of separate ticket + spec + plan + testcase + handoff files (those legacy folders are retained, read-only, non-default).

## Layout

| Folder | Record type | Template | Default for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `features/FEAT-XXX.md` | feature record | `templates/feature-record-template.md` | new standard feature (Mode B; Mode A when risk flag set) |
| `bugs/BUG-XXX.md` | bug record | `templates/bug-record-template.md` | new bug (Mode C) |
| `releases/REL-XXX.md` | release record | `templates/release-record-template.md` | a release (complements the release-checklist) |
| `decisions/DEC-XXX.md` | decision record | `templates/decision-record-template.md` | new durable decision (canonical store) |

## Rules (condensed — see `.ai/rules/no-duplicate-knowledge.md` + `generator-rules/output-file-rules.md` Rule 17a)

- **One record per work item.** Do NOT also create a separate `tickets/`, `specs/`, `plans/`, `testcases/`, or `handoff/` file for the same item.
- **Link, don't copy.** `decisions:` / `components:` in frontmatter are **links** (IDs), not restated content.
- **Decisions:** a new durable decision → `decisions/DEC-XXX.md` (full body) + a one-line index entry in `project-context/memory/DECISIONS.md` (compatibility pointer — the Navigator still resolves `adr_ref` via `DECISIONS.md`).
- **Legacy:** existing `tickets/`/`specs/`/`plans/`/`testcases/` files are read-only, excluded from default context loading, and may be consolidated into a record when touched (link them in the record's §References). They are not deleted eagerly.
- **Frontmatter contract:** feature/bug records carry the knowledge-consolidation fields (RM-07) that drive updates when the record reaches Done.

## Proof of concept

`features/FEAT-YVN39K.md` consolidates legacy **TASK-88NDV5** (ticket + spec + plan + testcase) and reconciles the Hyva-only(plan) ↔ dual-theme(spec, DEC-9) drift. The TASK-88NDV5 legacy files are marked legacy and point back here.
